LESSON: THE RICH YOUNG MAN

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Life of Jesus
Topic 3.8: The Rich Young Man

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: The Rich Young Man
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: how to inherit eternal life. Why was the rich young man unable to share his wealth?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. retell the story of the rich young man
2. apply lessons learnt from the story in their day-to- day lives
3. share resources with others as guided in the story
